description: Merged HPO phenotype frequency table with Wilson confidence intervals for MSH3-related AFAP
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from statsmodels.stats.proportion import proportion_confint

r=requests.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/api/ontologies/mondo/terms",
               params={"iri":"http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MONDO_0044300"},timeout=60)
t=r.json()["_embedded"]["terms"][0]
try:
    par=requests.get(t["_links"]["parents"]["href"],timeout=30).json()["_embedded"]["terms"]
    print("Parent terms:", [(p["obo_id"],p["label"]) for p in par])
except Exception as e: print("parents err:",e)

pheno = pd.DataFrame([
 ("HP:0005227","Adenomatous colonic polyposis",15,15,"full census (6 families)"),
 ("HP:0003003","Colon cancer",4,15,"full census"),
 ("HP:0004783","Duodenal polyposis",4,15,"full census"),
 ("HP:0003002","Breast carcinoma",3,5,"female patients only"),
 ("HP:0000131","Uterine leiomyoma",2,4,"HPO / Adam cohort"),
 ("HP:6000102","Breast intraductal papilloma",2,3,"HPO / Adam cohort"),
 ("HP:0000138","Ovarian cyst",1,4,"HPO / Adam cohort"),
 ("HP:0000107","Renal cyst",2,15,"HPO + Gavric"),
 ("HP:0001399","Hepatic cysts",4,15,"Aelvoet + Gavric"),
 ("HP:0000854","Thyroid adenoma",1,4,"HPO / Adam cohort"),
 ("HP:0033770","Gastric adenocarcinoma",1,15,"full census"),
 ("HP:0009592","Astrocytoma",1,15,"full census"),
 ("HP:0002671","Basal cell carcinoma",1,15,"full census"),
], columns=["hpo","label","k","n","source"])
pheno["freq"]=pheno.k/pheno.n
pheno[["lo","hi"]]=pd.DataFrame([proportion_confint(k,n,method="wilson") for k,n in zip(pheno.k,pheno.n)],index=pheno.index)
pheno["HPO_freq_class"]=pd.cut(pheno.freq,[-.01,.04,.29,.79,.99,1.0],
    labels=["Very rare HP:0040284","Occasional HP:0040283","Frequent HP:0040282",
            "Very frequent HP:0040281","Obligate HP:0040280"])
print("\nPhenotype frequency table:")
print(pheno.sort_values("freq",ascending=False).round(3).to_string(index=False))

p=pheno.sort_values("freq")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,6))
ax.errorbar(p.freq, range(len(p)), xerr=[p.freq-p.lo, p.hi-p.freq], fmt="o",
            color="#4C72B0", ecolor="#A0B4D4", capsize=3)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(p))); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{l}  ({h})" for l,h in zip(p.label,p.hpo)], fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("Frequency among reported biallelic MSH3 patients (Wilson 95% CI)")
ax.set_title("Phenotype spectrum of MSH3-related attenuated FAP\nColonic adenomatous polyposis is obligate, every other feature is uncommon with wide intervals")
ax.set_xlim(0,1.05); ax.grid(axis="x", alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
